svg.title: Covariance to joint functions to predictions

cc:Work.dc:title: Covariance to joint functions to predictions
cc:Work.dc:description: Forty-one function values share each independent Normal vector. Conditioning on two readings yields latent intervals; adding measurement variance 0.25 gives pointwise future-reading intervals. Neither band is a simultaneous curve region.
